input.$description: Background of editable fields and selection controls.

panel.$description: Background of panels containing controls or explanatory content.

chart.$description: Background of chart cards, matching the shared panel surface.

tooltip.$description: Background of exact-value hover details, matching the input surface.

secondary.$description: Supporting text and control labels with less emphasis than primary text.

muted.$description: Low-emphasis notes, captions, and supplementary explanations.

accent.$description: Emphasized metric values, small headings, and units.

link.$description: Text of navigable links and expandable exact-value details.

range-summary.$description: Summary of the selected time interval and observation count, using supporting-text emphasis.

stale.$description: Text indicating that the newest collected observation is stale.

error.$description: Validation errors and alert text on dashboard surfaces.

unavailable.$description: Unavailable-data notices, using low-emphasis supporting text.

default.$description: Resting background of primary buttons and related controls.

hover.$description: Background of primary controls while hovered.

default.$description: Resting background of secondary buttons and related controls.

hover.$description: Background of secondary controls while hovered.

control.$description: Boundary of outlined buttons and selected comparison chips.

input.$description: Boundary of editable fields and selection controls.

panel.$description: Boundary of panel surfaces and subdivisions within them, including table rows.

unavailable.$description: Dashed boundary of an unavailable-chart notice.

correlation.$description: Accent rule beside a correlation result.

body.$description: Ordered font fallback stack for body text and controls.

title.$description: Ordered serif fallback stack for the page title.

control.$description: Weight of control labels within buttons.

emphasis.$description: Weight of card headings and small emphasized labels.

body.$description: Unitless line-height multiplier for body text and controls.

title.$description: Unitless line-height multiplier for the page title.

eyebrow.$description: Letter spacing of uppercase introductory labels, multiplied by 1em in CSS.

minimum.$description: Lower font-size bound for the responsive page title.

maximum.$description: Upper font-size bound for the responsive page title.

viewport-factor.$description: Fluid page-title size, multiplied by 1vw between its minimum and maximum bounds.

body.$description: Default reading size for prose and controls.

body-small.$description: Compact supporting text, control labels, legends, and table content.

caption.$description: Short metric units and observation-count captions.

eyebrow.$description: Uppercase introductory label above the page title.

summary.$description: Exact headline counts, stronger than explanatory text and timestamps.

coefficient.$description: Prominent numeric correlation result, independently adjustable from headings.

disabled.$description: Opacity multiplier for disabled controls, from transparent (0) to opaque (1).

max-width.$description: Maximum width of the main dashboard content.
Maximum width of the complete-history download button.
Maximum width of a comparison-period input.

preferred-width.$description: Preferred width of a comparison-period input before wrapping; it may shrink on narrow screens.

min-width.$description: Minimum width of multi-series comparison plots; ordinary plots fit their container.

max-width.$description: Maximum source-note line length, multiplied by 1ch in CSS.

min-height.$description: Preferred minimum height for buttons and field controls.

compact-min-height.$description: Minimum height for compact disclosure and summary links, with surrounding space.

min-track-width.$description: Minimum readable track width for paired controls and summary cards before they stack.

hit-radius.$description: Maximum horizontal pointer distance from an observation in CSS pixels; hover shows matching observations across series.

series-min-height.$description: Minimum plot-area height reserved per comparison series so native three-line hover labels can appear together.

width.$description: Width of a series-color swatch beside its legend label.

height.$description: Height of a series-color swatch beside its legend label.

color.$description: Color of numeric and time tick labels inside the SVG chart.

font-size.$description: Tick-label font size in CSS pixels.

font-family.$description: Ordered font fallback stack for SVG axis tick labels.

color.$description: Color of axis lines and tick marks.

label-area.$description: Height reserved for horizontal-axis labels in CSS pixels.

range-padding.$description: Fraction of the selected time span reserved as a visual gutter at each horizontal boundary, keeping endpoint markers inside the hover area.

label-area.$description: Width reserved for vertical-axis labels in CSS pixels.

color.$description: Color of major grid lines behind plotted observations.

margin.$description: Inset around the plotting and label areas in CSS pixels.

min-height.$description: Minimum displayed chart height in CSS pixels; larger comparisons grow to accommodate simultaneous hover labels.

width.$description: Stroke width of a series line in CSS pixels.

radius.$description: Radius of a visible observation marker in CSS pixels.

hue-step.$description: Fraction of a full hue turn advanced per series when generating colors beyond the explicit palette.

saturation.$description: HSL saturation of generated additional-series colors, from 0 to 1.

lightness.$description: HSL lightness of generated additional-series colors, from 0 to 1.

alpha.$description: Opacity of generated additional-series colors, from transparent (0) to opaque (1).

01.$description: Color for comparison series position 1; the position does not identify a particular server or metric.

02.$description: Color for comparison series position 2; the position does not identify a particular server or metric.

03.$description: Color for comparison series position 3; the position does not identify a particular server or metric.

04.$description: Color for comparison series position 4; the position does not identify a particular server or metric.

05.$description: Color for comparison series position 5; the position does not identify a particular server or metric.

06.$description: Color for comparison series position 6; the position does not identify a particular server or metric.

offset.$description: Distance between a keyboard-focus outline and the focused element.

width.$description: Width of the keyboard-focus outline, independently adjustable from decorative rules.

default.$description: Thin boundary around controls, panels, and table subdivisions.

correlation.$description: Accent rule width beside a correlation result.

input.$description: Corner rounding of input fields and unavailable-data notices.

panel.$description: Corner rounding of content panels and chart cards.

detail.$description: Corner rounding of fieldsets and comparison chips.

medium.$description: Maximum viewport width for single-column charts and the intermediate control layout.

narrow.$description: Maximum viewport width for stacked controls and compact page and panel padding.

inline.$description: Padding at the inline edges of the main page content.

block.$description: Page padding above and below content on narrow screens.

inline.$description: Page padding at inline edges on narrow screens.

stack.$description: Vertical separation between major dashboard sections.

compact-padding.$description: Inner padding of panels and chart cards on narrow screens.

padding.$description: Inner padding of individual metric cards.

inline.$description: Inline padding of compact remove-selection buttons.

inline.$description: Inline padding inside a selected-comparison chip.

block.$description: Vertical padding inside table header and data cells.

inline.$description: Inline padding inside table header and data cells.

padding.$description: Inner padding of grouped comparison choices.

legend-padding.$description: Inline padding separating a fieldset legend from its border.

block.$description: Vertical padding inside the latest-collection summary band.

tight.$description: Minimal separation between closely related detail rows or text and an interactive edge.

small.$description: Separation between a label and its control, or between short related text elements.

large.$description: Separation between groups of controls or content within a section.

extra-large.$description: Separation between larger content groups within a section.

gap.$description: Separation between metric cards in the chart grid.

skip-link.$description: Stacking layer for the keyboard skip link above page content.
